cine: A cinematic film still from a Taiwanese high-school drama, shot on Kodak Vision3 250D film with an anamorphic 50mm lens at f/2.2. Bright overcast daylight, soft even light, soft natural shadows, a natural neutral colour grade with healthy skin tones, shallow depth of field, natural faces and expressions, subtle film grain. Full-frame image, NO black letterbox bars.
set_sentence: Use the location from <image{n}> as the set (same architecture, windows, furniture and light direction), but only as the location.
frame_suffix: The stated framing is exact: do not widen the shot and do not show more of the body than the framing states. Only the people described appear in the frame, exactly as many as stated. Short-sleeve shirts with bare forearms. No text, no watermark, no captions, no readable writing or logos on any surface or clothing.

snippets.CORRIDOR: Behind them is the ground-floor open-air school corridor, looking down its length: on the LEFT side of the frame a row of square speckled-grey terrazzo pillars with open air and a green lawn between them (NO railing, NO wall, NO balcony); on the RIGHT side of the frame the classroom wall: red brick ONLY from the floor up to the window sills, a white concrete window ledge, tall dark-framed windows separated by speckled dark-grey pebble-wash wall piers, a pale cream plaster wall above the windows; the wall runs continuously across the frame with no plain blank wall section. Bright overcast daylight, soft even light.
snippets.CLASSROOM: Behind them is an ordinary enclosed Taiwanese high-school classroom: pale grey desktops on silver metal frames, teal-green plastic chairs, a speckled grey terrazzo floor, fluorescent tube lights and white ceiling fans, pale green curtains; no corridor and no open doorway is visible.

h3.style: a realistic cinematic live-action Taiwanese high-school drama shot on anamorphic lenses, 35mm grain, natural light
h3.setting: a Taiwanese public high school by day, soft overcast daylight

setting_by_scene.class: an enclosed Taiwanese public high school classroom by day, soft even daylight and fluorescent light; the room is enclosed and no corridor or hallway is visible
setting_by_scene.corridor: the ground-floor open-air corridor outside a Taiwanese public high school classroom by day, square pillars and a lawn on one side and the classroom wall on the other; no railing, no balcony, soft overcast daylight

h3.soundscape: Quiet daytime school ambience, a distant electric fan, faint footsteps and voices far away.
h3.camera: The camera holds a static shot on a tripod.
constraints: No new people appear that are not already in the first frame; no captions and no readable text anywhere; no logos.
The camera stays locked on the tripod; no zoom, no pan.
LOCKED-OFF STATIC CAMERA on a tripod.
Background people stay in place and barely move; only the people described in the action move; no objects are added or removed.
The teacher never touches any student.
h3.dmad_note: 2026-10-23 實驗：4 步壓不住首幀、動作大會換臉；8 步／0.8 ＝ 20 步的穩定度、時間約一半（docs/10）

stu.name: 學生甲
stu.look: Xiaoming, a 17-year-old Taiwanese high-school boy, about 170 cm, slim build, light skin, an oval face, short black hair with a side fringe, an ordinary-looking real Taiwanese teenager (not a model, natural unretouched skin), wearing the school summer uniform: a light powder-blue SHORT-sleeve collared button-up shirt (short sleeves ending above the elbow, bare forearms, never long sleeves) worn untucked, with a small red embroidered mark above the left chest pocket (no readable text)
stu.look_full: （同 look，再加上下半身與鞋子：…, charcoal-grey straight-leg school trousers and black leather school shoes）只給 LoRA 訓練與全身鏡參考，make_film 不讀

bg_inpaint._comment: 只有首幀背景不像實景、要事後補救時才用（tools/bg_inpaint.py）；新片用實景照當母版通常不需要

class.prompt: Realistic film still. The background is an ordinary enclosed Taiwanese high-school classroom exactly like the reference photo <image1>: pale grey desktops on silver metal frames, teal-green plastic chairs, a speckled grey terrazzo floor, long fluorescent tube lights and white ceiling fans, pale green curtains on the windows, a dark green chalkboard. Soft even daylight plus fluorescent light, no hard sunlight. The room is enclosed: no corridor, no hallway, no open doorway. No signs or plaques. Shallow depth of field, the background softly out of focus. No text, no readable writing.

corridor.prompt: Realistic film still. The background is the ground-floor open-air school corridor exactly like the reference photo <image1>: square speckled-grey terrazzo pillars with open air and a green lawn between them, a classroom wall with red brick only below the window sills, white concrete window ledges, dark-framed windows, speckled grey pebble-wash wall piers, a speckled terrazzo floor. No railing, no balcony, no class-number signs or plaques. Bright overcast daylight, soft light. Shallow depth of field. No text, no readable writing.

bg_inpaint.negative: low quality, watermark, text, numbers, sign, plaque, wooden desks, railing

shots.frame: Medium close-up at eye level, chest-up framing: the woman from <image1> stands at the front of the classroom from <image2>, looking out toward the students with a calm, businesslike face. FRAMING: chest-up; the head and shoulders fill the frame, and the waist, legs and shoes are outside the frame. The windows are on the left side of the frame.
shots.action: The teacher looks out over the class and calmly gives a short instruction, then waits.
shots._note: 對白鏡＝單人近景（臉要大，H3 嘴型才清楚）；景別寫在句首，並寫明到身體哪裡

line.text: 老師，我的作業被狗吃掉了。

shots.frame: Medium close-up at seated eye level, chest-up framing: the boy from <image1> sits at his desk in the classroom from <image2>, raising one hand, with a forced innocent smile. {CLASSROOM} FRAMING: chest-up; the waist, legs and shoes are outside the frame.
shots.action: The boy keeps his hand raised and, with a forced innocent smile, makes his excuse toward the front of the room.
shots._note: {CLASSROOM} 會換成 snippets.CLASSROOM；坐著的人物近景要配坐姿高度拍的機位參考照

alt.prompt: Edit <image1>: keep this exact school corridor, same pillars, wall, terrazzo floor and soft daylight, but frame it as a medium wide side view across the corridor. Add exactly one teenage boy walking from left to right in profile, full body from head to shoes, empty hands: a slim 17-year-old Taiwanese boy with short black hair, a light powder-blue SHORT-sleeve school shirt (bare forearms), charcoal-grey school trousers and black school shoes. Realistic photograph. No other people. No text, no watermark, no readable writing or logos anywhere.

shots.frame_method: 多人或全身走位鏡：用 tools/alt_frames.py 的 photo 方法（實景照上加人、側面構圖），挑好後複製成 out/first/S03.png
shots.frame: Medium wide side view across the corridor from <image2>: the boy from <image1> walks from left to right in profile, empty hands. FRAMING: full body from head to shoes. Below the waist he wears charcoal-grey school trousers and black leather school shoes.
shots.action: The boy keeps walking from left to right at a normal pace and leaves the frame on the right.
constraints: No new people appear that are not already in the first frame; no captions and no readable text anywhere; no logos.
The camera stays locked on the tripod; no zoom, no pan.
